description: Mark the always-present members of the AccessToken definition as required, and its `sha1` sensitive. Forgejo's Swagger is generated from Go structs with no `required` lists at all, so a token's `id`, `name`, `token_last_eight` and `created_at` type as optional even though they are plain struct members serialized on every response. `sha1` is the generated secret, returned only by the create response and empty on every later read — it stays optional, but is flagged sensitive so the SDK hands it out Redacted.
